entities.name: Madarrak
entities.description: An aging Izzet mage who hunts Erno Zslod's teleportal device and is mentor to Castan.

entities.name: Castan
entities.description: A vedalken Izzet attendant to Madarrak who unleashes lightning on kraul and is left behind in the sewers.

entities.name: Erno Zslod
entities.description: An Izzet chemister who vanished from his lab over thirty years ago and is found transformed into a glowing face inside a mizzium suit.

entities.name: Yzaak
entities.description: A hulking Cyclops with mizzium augmentations who accompanies Madarrak and is found decomposed in the sewers.

entities.name: Johrum
entities.description: Erno Zslod's attendant, who began to change into a mutant and was collected by creatures from the darkness.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet guildmaster, to whom Madarrak reports that Erno's device works.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of mages and inventors that Madarrak and Castan serve.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of rot farmers that has condemned the sewer territory and keeps watch to stop anything from coming out.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: The guild of biomancers, whom Madarrak suspects of testing on Castan.

entities.name: kraul
entities.description: Insectoid warriors with carapaces and axes who swarm the sewer chamber.

entities.name: Nivix
aliases: guild tower of the Izzet League

entities.name: hypermana focusing lens
entities.description: A mizzium device designed by Erno Zslod that brought him and his attendant to the sewers and works as a teleportal.

entities.name: mizzium receiver
entities.description: A pulsing receiver that led Madarrak to Erno and later signals again.

events.summary: Madarrak and Castan find Erno Zslod's mind in a mizzium suit in the sewer.
Erno confesses that he tampered with his lens after meeting with others and believes his mind was controlled; the device brought them to the sewer and transformed him.
events.quote: They had hold of my mind!

events.summary: Madarrak finds the device canister, and insect-legged kraul warriors appear.
Castan kills three kraul with lightning.
events.quote: The creatures each tumbled to the ground mid-stride as three lifeless husks.

events.summary: A mutant pins Madarrak while kraul surround Castan; the mutant tears Erno's suit in two before Madarrak scalds it with steam.
events.quote: The mutant tore what was left of Erno Zslod in two.

events.summary: Madarrak flees to Yzaak and finds the Cyclops decomposed, the mizzium corroded and fungus sprouting.
events.quote: The light that washed over the scene revealed the Cyclops to be in a state of decomposition.

events.summary: Madarrak activates the device and is teleported back to Nivix.
events.quote: Erno's device worked, and he must report that to Niv-Mizzet at once.

events.summary: Madarrak, back in Niv-Mizzet's good graces, finds the receiver pulsing again and resolves to rescue Castan.
events.quote: he would not leave his attendant to the twisted tests of the Simic.

events.summary: Madarrak boards the repaired construct using Castan's improvements, then sees a blue-green drip and fears he is infected.
events.quote: Horror swept over him, and he brought a shaky hand to his nose.

relations.quote: The old man, back in the Dracogenius's good graces after delivering Erno's teleportal
the Izzet chemister who disappeared from his lab more than thirty years ago
But they collected my attendant, Johrum
They were making sure nothing came out.
